name: PgDog
title: pgdog.dev
shortDescription: PgDog acts as a routing layer for PostgreSQL, enhancing its scalability by managing data movement across nodes and directing query traffic transparently. Ideal for businesses using PostgreSQL in cloud environments like AWS RDS and Google Cloud SQL, PgDog ensures efficient data sharding without downtime, leveraging logical replication. This makes PostgreSQL as swift as any NoSQL database, supporting complex queries across shards without sacrificing data relationships.
pros: Operates outside the database, easy cloud integration
cons: May introduce complexity in database management
Dependent on the underlying hardware for performance
